filters_body: Narrow the list down. Swipe the sheet down, press outside or press Escape to close it.
placement_body: A sheet can come from any edge. Start and end follow the reading direction.
snap_body: It opens at a 200 px peek. Swipe it up to the full height, or down past the peek to close it.
sequential_body: Three stops: a 148 px peek, 355 px, then the full height. One swipe can pass several of them.
backdrop_body: The page behind stays blocked whatever the backdrop looks like.
locked_body: This sheet cannot be swiped away, and a press outside or Escape does nothing. Use the button to close it.
scroll_body: At the peek a swipe expands the sheet; once it is fully open the list scrolls.
detached_body: It floats clear of the screen's edges with every corner rounded.
controlled_body: The app holds the open state and can close it from anywhere.
handle_body: With a mouse, drag the bar at the top to move the sheet. On a touch screen the whole panel moves until it is fully open.
nested_body: Open another sheet from here: this one scales back and the new one slides over it.
nested_child_body: Swipe it down, or press Back, to return to the parent.
nested_deeper_body: Each sheet under this one scales back a little more.
